people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.
translations.bsb: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, you will no longer quote this proverb in Israel.
translations.kjv: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.
translations.asv: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.
